    StartersRaptor egg devilled eggsDevilled eggs with Dijon and chives, dusted with smoked paprikaHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp snipped chivessmoked paprika, to dustBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel.Halve and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, Dijon and chives until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and dust with paprika so they look speckled like eggs from a nest.Isla Sorna tostones with garlic lime mojoTwice-fried green plantain, smashed and salted, with garlic lime mojoHow to make it3 green plantains1 L vegetable oil1 tsp salt3 garlic cloves, crushed2 limes, juiced4 tbsp olive oil2 tbsp chopped corianderPeel the plantains and cut into thick pieces. Mix the garlic, lime juice, olive oil, coriander and a pinch of salt for the mojo.Fry the plantain at 160°C for 4 minutes until soft but pale. Drain and smash each flat with a heavy glass.Fry again at 190°C for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then salt well.Serve hot with the mojo for dipping.Parasail chilli lime prawn skewersEric and Ben parasailing over the islandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Garlic, chilli and lime prawns threaded on skewers and grilled over high heat, with a sweet mango and red onion salsa.Toss 800g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, the zest and juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp olive oil, and leave for 20 minutes.Thread onto 8 skewers.Dice 2 mangoes with half a red onion, a handful of coriander and the juice of another lime.Grill the skewers over high heat for 2 minutes a side until pink and charred.Serve with the salsa and lime wedges.Grilled corn with chilli and limeBilly's satchel held raptor eggs. Simmer covered until the rice is tender, then stir through the coriander.Fry the eggs and mix the tomatoes with a little salt for a fresh salsa.Serve the rice topped with fried eggs and salsa.Ellie's lemon and thyme roast chickenGrant visiting Ellie and her family at homeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy.Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and thyme, rub with butter and salt, and roast at 200°C for 1 hour 20 minutes.Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil alongside for 50 minutes.Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey for 35 minutes.Rest the chicken, then stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices with 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.SweetsPteranodon nest pavlovasSmall meringue nests filled with whipped cream and passionfruitHow to make it3 egg whites170g caster sugar300ml thickened cream, whipped3 passionfruits12 blueberriesWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Pipe into small nests and bake at 120°C.
